cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Sr Robotics Manufacturing Engineer specializing in robotic end effectors to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
End Effector Design: Design and develop robotic end effectors tailored to specific applications, considering factors such as payload capacity, precision, and environmental constraints.
Mechanical Engineering: Apply principles of mechanical engineering to create robust and reliable end effector designs. Ensure designs meet performance requirements and adhere to industry standards.
Prototyping and Testing: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to prototype end effector designs and conduct thorough testing. Analyze test results to iterate and refine designs for optimal performance.
Material Selection: Evaluate and select appropriate materials for end effector components, considering factors such as strength, weight, and durability. Optimize designs for cost-effectiveness without compromising quality.
CAD Modeling: Utilize CAD software to create detailed 3D models and technical drawings of end effector assemblies. Generate accurate documentation for manufacturing and assembly processes.
Manufacturing Support: Work closely with manufacturing partners to ensure seamless transition from design to production. Provide guidance and support to resolve any manufacturing challenges or issues that arise.
Innovation and Improvement: Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends related to robotic end effectors. Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve end effector designs for enhanced performance and efficiency.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with software engineers, electrical engineers, and other stakeholders to integrate end effectors into robotic systems. Communicate effectively and contribute to a cohesive team environment.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
3+ Years of experience in mechanical design, specifically in robotic end effectors.
Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD) for 3D modeling and drafting.
Strong understanding of mechanical principles and design fundamentals.
Experience with prototyping, testing, and iteration of mechanical designs.
Knowledge of materials selection and manufacturing processes relevant to robotics.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Effective communication and teamwork abilities.
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Interest in robotics and a desire to contribute to the advancement of automation technology.

End Effector Design: Design and develop robotic end effectors tailored to specific applications, considering factors such as payload capacity, precision, and environmental constraints.
Mechanical Engineering: Apply principles of mechanical engineering to create robust and reliable end effector designs. Ensure designs meet performance requirements and adhere to industry standards.
Prototyping and Testing: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to prototype end effector designs and conduct thorough testing. Analyze test results to iterate and refine designs for optimal performance.
Material Selection: Evaluate and select appropriate materials for end effector components, considering factors such as strength, weight, and durability. Optimize designs for cost-effectiveness without compromising quality.
CAD Modeling: Utilize CAD software to create detailed 3D models and technical drawings of end effector assemblies. Generate accurate documentation for manufacturing and assembly processes.
Manufacturing Support: Work closely with manufacturing partners to ensure seamless transition from design to production. Provide guidance and support to resolve any manufacturing challenges or issues that arise.
Innovation and Improvement: Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends related to robotic end effectors. Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve end effector designs for enhanced performance and efficiency.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with software engineers, electrical engineers, and other stakeholders to integrate end effectors into robotic systems. Communicate effectively and contribute to a cohesive team environment.
cond_0155.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Proven track record in mechanical design, with demonstrated expertise specifically in robotic end effectors.
Deep knowledge of CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD) for 3D modeling and drafting.
Strong command of mechanical principles and design fundamentals.
Substantial experience with prototyping, testing, and iteration of mechanical designs.
Advanced knowledge of materials selection and manufacturing processes relevant to robotics.
Exceptional problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Genuine interest in robotics and a desire to contribute to the advancement of automation technology.

End Effector Design: Design and develop robotic end effectors tailored to specific applications, considering factors such as payload capacity, precision, and environmental constraints.
Mechanical Engineering: Apply principles of mechanical engineering to create robust and reliable end effector designs. Ensure designs meet performance requirements and adhere to industry standards.
Prototyping and Testing: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to prototype end effector designs and conduct thorough testing. Analyze test results to iterate and refine designs for optimal performance.
Material Selection: Evaluate and select appropriate materials for end effector components, considering factors such as strength, weight, and durability. Optimize designs for cost-effectiveness without compromising quality.
CAD Modeling: Utilize CAD software to create detailed 3D models and technical drawings of end effector assemblies. Generate accurate documentation for manufacturing and assembly processes.
Manufacturing Support: Work closely with manufacturing partners to ensure seamless transition from design to production. Provide guidance and support to resolve any manufacturing challenges or issues that arise.
Innovation and Improvement: Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends related to robotic end effectors. Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve end effector designs for enhanced performance and efficiency.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with software engineers, electrical engineers, and other stakeholders to integrate end effectors into robotic systems. Communicate effectively and contribute to a cohesive team environment.
cond_0191.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Proven track record in mechanical design, with demonstrated expertise specifically in robotic end effectors.
Deep knowledge of CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD) for 3D modeling and drafting.
Strong command of mechanical principles and design fundamentals.
Substantial experience with prototyping, testing, and iteration of mechanical designs.
Advanced knowledge of materials selection and manufacturing processes relevant to robotics.
Exceptional problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Genuine interest in robotics and a desire to contribute to the advancement of automation technology.
cond_0191.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0191.values: We value work that supports people well and reflects genuine care in how it is done. We believe responsibility and respect matter as much as the end result.

cond_0219.intro: We are looking for a Sr Robotics Manufacturing Engineer to join our team.
cond_0219.responsibilities:
End Effector Design: Design and develop robotic end effectors tailored to specific applications, considering factors such as payload capacity, precision, and environmental constraints.
Mechanical Engineering: Apply principles of mechanical engineering to create robust and reliable end effector designs. Ensure designs meet performance requirements and adhere to industry standards.
Prototyping and Testing: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to prototype end effector designs and conduct thorough testing. Analyze test results to iterate and refine designs for optimal performance.
Material Selection: Evaluate and select appropriate materials for end effector components, considering factors such as strength, weight, and durability. Optimize designs for cost-effectiveness without compromising quality.
CAD Modeling: Utilize CAD software to create detailed 3D models and technical drawings of end effector assemblies. Generate accurate documentation for manufacturing and assembly processes.
Manufacturing Support: Work closely with manufacturing partners to ensure seamless transition from design to production. Provide guidance and support to resolve any manufacturing challenges or issues that arise.
Innovation and Improvement: Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends related to robotic end effectors. Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve end effector designs for enhanced performance and efficiency.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with software engineers, electrical engineers, and other stakeholders to integrate end effectors into robotic systems. Communicate effectively and contribute to a cohesive team environment.

Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 3 years of experience in mechanical design, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Working knowledge of CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD) for 3D modeling and drafting.
Background in mechanical principles and design fundamentals.
Experience with prototyping, testing, and iteration of mechanical designs.

Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
Familiarity with materials selection and manufacturing processes relevant to robotics, with willingness to deepen that knowledge on the job.
Ability to communicate effectively and work well with others across teams.
Comfort working independently and managing multiple projects at once.
Interest in robotics and automation technology.

Your work will contribute to the advancement of robotic systems, enhancing their capabilities and efficiency. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with end effector design and robotics work.
cond_0230.responsibilities:
End Effector Design: Design and develop robotic end effectors tailored to specific applications, considering factors such as payload capacity, precision, and environmental constraints.
Mechanical Engineering: Apply principles of mechanical engineering to create robust and reliable end effector designs. Ensure designs meet performance requirements and adhere to industry standards.
Prototyping and Testing: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to prototype end effector designs and conduct thorough testing. Analyze test results to iterate and refine designs for optimal performance.
Material Selection: Evaluate and select appropriate materials for end effector components, considering factors such as strength, weight, and durability. Optimize designs for cost-effectiveness without compromising quality.
CAD Modeling: Utilize CAD software to create detailed 3D models and technical drawings of end effector assemblies. Generate accurate documentation for manufacturing and assembly processes.
Manufacturing Support: Work closely with manufacturing partners to ensure seamless transition from design to production. Provide guidance and support to resolve any manufacturing challenges or issues that arise.
Innovation and Improvement: Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends related to robotic end effectors. Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve end effector designs for enhanced performance and efficiency.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with software engineers, electrical engineers, and other stakeholders to integrate end effectors into robotic systems. Communicate effectively and contribute to a cohesive team environment.
cond_0230.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field; Master's degree preferred.
Proven experience in mechanical design, specifically in the field of robotic end effectors.
Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD) for 3D modeling and drafting.
Strong understanding of mechanical principles and design fundamentals.
Experience with prototyping, testing, and iteration of mechanical designs.
Knowledge of materials selection and manufacturing processes relevant to robotics.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Effective communication and teamwork abilities.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Passion for robotics and a desire to contribute to the advancement of automation technology.

End Effector Design: Design and develop robotic end effectors tailored to specific applications, considering factors such as payload capacity, precision, and environmental constraints.
Mechanical Engineering: Apply principles of mechanical engineering to create robust and reliable end effector designs. Ensure designs meet performance requirements and adhere to industry standards.
Prototyping and Testing: Work closely with cross-functional teams to prototype end effector designs and conduct thorough testing. Stay in regular contact with team members to analyze test results and iterate on designs for optimal performance.
Material Selection: Evaluate and select appropriate materials for end effector components, considering factors such as strength, weight, and durability. Optimize designs for cost-effectiveness without compromising quality.
CAD Modeling: Utilize CAD software to create detailed 3D models and technical drawings of end effector assemblies. Generate accurate documentation for manufacturing and assembly processes.
Manufacturing Support: Stay in close contact with manufacturing partners to ensure a smooth transition from design to production. Actively raise and resolve manufacturing challenges or issues as they come up.
Innovation and Improvement: Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends related to robotic end effectors. Continuously seek opportunities to improve end effector designs for enhanced performance and efficiency.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work daily with software engineers, electrical engineers, and other stakeholders to integrate end effectors into robotic systems. Communicate clearly, initiate discussions to keep alignment, and contribute to a cohesive team environment.
cond_0348.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field
Proven experience in mechanical design, specifically in robotic end effectors
Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD) for 3D modeling and drafting
Strong understanding of mechanical principles and design fundamentals
Experience with prototyping, testing, and iteration of mechanical designs
Knowledge of materials selection and manufacturing processes relevant to robotics
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Effective communication and teamwork abilities
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field
Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously
Interest in robotics and a desire to contribute to the advancement of automation technology

End Effector Design: Design and develop robotic end effectors tailored to specific applications, considering factors such as payload capacity, precision, and environmental constraints.
Mechanical Engineering: Apply principles of mechanical engineering to create robust and reliable end effector designs. Ensure designs meet performance requirements and adhere to industry standards.
Prototyping and Testing: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to prototype end effector designs and conduct thorough testing. Analyze test results to iterate and refine designs for optimal performance.
Material Selection: Evaluate and select appropriate materials for end effector components, considering factors such as strength, weight, and durability. Optimize designs for cost-effectiveness without compromising quality.
CAD Modeling: Utilize CAD software to create detailed 3D models and technical drawings of end effector assemblies. Generate accurate documentation for manufacturing and assembly processes.
Manufacturing Support: Work closely with manufacturing partners to ensure seamless transition from design to production. Provide guidance and support to resolve any manufacturing challenges or issues that arise.
Innovation and Improvement: Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends related to robotic end effectors. Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve end effector designs for enhanced performance and efficiency.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with software engineers, electrical engineers, and other stakeholders to integrate end effectors into robotic systems. Communicate effectively and contribute to a cohesive team environment.
cond_0361.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
3+ Years of experience in mechanical design, specifically in robotic end effectors.
Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD) for 3D modeling and drafting.
Strong understanding of mechanical principles and design fundamentals.
Experience with prototyping, testing, and iteration of mechanical designs.
Knowledge of materials selection and manufacturing processes relevant to robotics.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Effective communication and teamwork abilities.
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Interest in robotics and a desire to contribute to the advancement of automation technology.

Your work will contribute to the advancement of robotic systems, enhancing their capabilities and efficiency. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of end effector design and how mechanical constraints shape the solution.
cond_0436.responsibilities:
End Effector Design: Design and develop robotic end effectors tailored to specific applications, considering factors such as payload capacity, precision, and environmental constraints.
Mechanical Engineering: Apply principles of mechanical engineering to create robust and reliable end effector designs. Ensure designs meet performance requirements and adhere to industry standards.
Prototyping and Testing: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to prototype end effector designs and conduct thorough testing. Analyze test results to iterate and refine designs for optimal performance.
Material Selection: Evaluate and select appropriate materials for end effector components, considering factors such as strength, weight, and durability. Optimize designs for cost-effectiveness without compromising quality.
CAD Modeling: Utilize CAD software to create detailed 3D models and technical drawings of end effector assemblies. Generate accurate documentation for manufacturing and assembly processes.
Manufacturing Support: Work closely with manufacturing partners to ensure seamless transition from design to production. Provide guidance and support to resolve any manufacturing challenges or issues that arise.
Innovation and Improvement: Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends related to robotic end effectors. Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve end effector designs for enhanced performance and efficiency.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with software engineers, electrical engineers, and other stakeholders to integrate end effectors into robotic systems. Communicate effectively and contribute to a cohesive team environment.
cond_0436.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Proven experience in mechanical design, specifically in the field of robotic end effectors.
Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD) for 3D modeling and drafting.
Strong understanding of mechanical principles and design fundamentals.
Experience with prototyping, testing, and iteration of mechanical designs.
Knowledge of materials selection and manufacturing processes relevant to robotics.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Effective communication and teamwork abilities.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field; Master's degree a plus.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Interest in robotics and a desire to contribute to the advancement of automation technology.
